target_zone_range.guardrail: Exact county evidence only; historical variety labels are reconciled to current accepted taxonomy.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with life cycle and the bracts. Texas paintbrush is an annual, usually with bright red to orange-red showy bracts and a more compact spring-flowering habit than the perennial prairie paintbrushes.
diagnostic_traits: upper leaves/bracts brightly red to orange-red
showy color comes mainly from bracts rather than petals

comparisons.key_distinctions: C. purpurea and C. lindheimeri are perennial. C. indivisa is the annual Texas paintbrush and usually looks more compact and uniformly scarlet-red.
